{{Quote|Do forgive me for not shaking hands. My hospitality exceeds my reach, heh&hellip;|Oteg|<ref name="TOR:TJP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|The Jedi Prisoner|the ''Telos''}}</ref>}}
'''Oteg''' was a revered [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the ensuing [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Oteg commanded the Republic's [[First Expeditionary Fleet]], which fought against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the Cold War and the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Welcome, my friends! I appreciate you all for coming all this way.|Oteg greeting the strike team|<ref name="TOR:TJP" />}}
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] member of a [[Yoda's species/Legends|long-lived species]], Oteg was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] two centuries before the start of the [[Great Galactic War]]. Earning the rank of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], Oteg was serving aboard the Republic starship ''[[Sarapin Wanderer]]'' during the Great Galactic War with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] when it was attacked and its captain killed. Taking command and organizing a counterattack, Oteg proved his prowess in warfare when he drove the Imperial fleet into a nearby nebula and tricked them into detonating the gases of the nebula to destroy the fleet.<ref name="SWTORE" />

Upon returning to Republic space after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] went into effect, Oteg was appointed to the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] and would aid in leading the Order until the peace brought on by the treaty began to erode. As conflicts began to shatter the peace, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] recommended that Oteg fill the role of [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Fleet Admiral]]. With the approval of [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]], Oteg left the Council and took command of the [[First Expeditionary Fleet]] from the bridge of the Republic [[Valor-class cruiser|dreadnought]] [[Telos (Valor-class)|''Telos'']].<ref name="SWTORE" />

[[File:Oteg_1.png|thumb|left|240px|Oteg meditates aboard the ''Telos'']]
During the war he summoned an elite four man strike team to converse with the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of [[Meetra Surik]], telling them of a Jedi Master held prisoner by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He directed the ensuing [[Battle of Taral V|operation]] to obtain the means to liberate the Jedi Master&mdash;later revealed to be the legendary [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;which involved obtaining a [[Gree/Legends|Gree]] [[Gree computer|key]]. Once the computer had been obtained, the Jedi Master went on to command the fleet into the Maelstrom and engage the Imperial Fifth Fleet under [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Rycus Kilran]], stationed at the prison facility. Being cornered by both the Imperial fleet and the station's weaponry, he would communicate to the Republic strike team inside the station and informing them of the situation, they would tell him to pull back, in effect saving Oteg's life and the flagship, while they freed Revan. After Revan's rescue, Master Oteg welcomed him aboard the ''Telos''.<ref name="TaralV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Oteg was voiced by [[Jim Cummings]]. He is one of two known members of his species, the other being [[Vandar Tokare]], to use standard grammar, rather than the distinctive dialect used by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] and [[Yaddle/Legends|Yaddle]].

If the player chooses the dark side option in the Maelstrom Prison flashpoint, Oteg dies as the bridge of the ''Telos'' is destroyed.
